ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips and lateral margins of both lobes. The left lobe features a distinct pattern of parallel, vertically oriented high-contrast linear white bands. The central and proximal fluke areas are dominated by a contiguous dark-intensity region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a deep, irregular V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 50 degrees; the depth of the notch occupies approximately 25% of the visible vertical height of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys (jagged serrations) are extracted along the medial portions of the trailing edge; distal portions exhibit lower frequency, more rounded pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe outer edge follows a convex curve trajectory; the right lobe outer edge is predominantly linear with a slight concave inflection observed near the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple discrete circular high-intensity pixel clusters localized within the dark-pigmented region of the lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent series of parallel, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) is mapped across the mid-section of the left lobe; multiple unaligned, shorter linear pixel disruptions are visible within the central dark-pigmented area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive non-uniform tissue loss and jagged cicatrization along the trailing edge boundary, particularly concentrated at the median notch; extensive field of linear rake marks across the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique shredded or torn morphology of the interior trailing edge boundary combined with high-density vertical banding on the left lobe.
